business_problem: The existing technology was outdated, lacking cloud services and other essential infrastructure. Babson required help to manage the expedition and provisioning required for student grants and other projects.
solution_summary: Babson College used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Studio, Microsoft Dynamics 365 to surface grounded answers from enterprise knowledge faster. The existing technology was outdated, lacking cloud services and other essential infrastructure. Babson required help to manage the expedition and provisioning required for student grants and other projects. Key implementation elements included Azure OpenAI Service generates natural-language responses and task automation for the solution; Azure AI Studio provides the workspace for building, testing, and deploying the AI application; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Power BI delivers reports and dashboards to business users. Enterprise content from documents, meetings, websites, or internal systems is passed through retrieval and model services so users receive grounded answers inside the target workflow.
